fact: A Council of Ministers decree that came into force in April 2026 created the National Commission for Artificial Intelligence (CNIA), subordinate to the Council of Ministers, to advise the Government on ethical, legal, security and social issues of AI, as reported by Lusa via Club of Mozambique.

A law journal article by Bitone Viage says Mozambique has no specific legal provisions on AI-enabled digital crime such as deepfakes, algorithmic manipulation of data and automated attacks, a significant normative void.
